transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I'm just here because... well, it's about my husband's sister. She's been, um, working her way into the family business. Trying to get control of the money, mostly. Pushing me out of the decisions. People keep trying to smooth it over, but... I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for over a year now.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No. I don't... I haven't heard anything like that. I don't know why you'd ask me that.
Outside of this situation with your sister-in-law, do you generally feel that people in your life cannot be trusted?
No, not really. I mean, I trust my husband. And my friends are fine. It's just... just her.
Have you had any periods where you felt severely depressed, or on the other hand, unusually high or full of energy?
No. I don't... I haven't really had anything like that. Just my normal self.
